model_annotation: The bar chart displays the monthly percentage values for the years 2022, 2023, and 2024, with the horizontal axis representing the months (I–XII) and the vertical axis showing the percentage values ranging from 0,000 to 140,000. Each month has three bars corresponding to the years 2022 (blue), 2023 (orange), and 2024 (gray). The data reveals that the highest values for all three years occur in December (XII), with 2022 reaching approximately 128,000%, 2023 around 82,000%, and 2024 at about 112,000%. The lowest values are observed in August (VIII), with 2022 at approximately 82,000%, 2023 at about 81,000%, and 2024 at roughly 102,000%. The values for 2024 generally exceed those of 2022 and 2023 in most months, with a notable peak in December.
